snippet.title: Realindustry – Official Gameplay Trailer | From Primitive Tools to Quantum Tech
snippet.description:
Experience the most authentic industrial simulation ever created.

In Realindustry, every resource has a chemical formula, and every recipe follows real-world industrial logic. You don't just "craft" items — you master metallurgy, chemistry, and semiconductor fabrication to build the ultimate goal of humanity: the Hyperdrive Engine.

Key Features:
231 Real Materials: From basic wood to Antimatter and Exotic Matter.
352 Production Processes: Authentic manufacturing based on scientific research.
56 Industrial Facilities: Meticulously designed with unique acoustic environments.
139 Research Technologies: A massive web of dependencies from the Stone Age to the future.

Build your empire. Optimize your chains. Discover the truth behind the corporation.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4384850/Realindustry/
Follow us on X: https://x.com/RealindustryDev

#Realindustry #Trailer #Tycoon #Strategy #IndieGame #Science
